newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent one cent up late session, quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent one cent up late session, quiet trade.

text.p: Brent crude futures prices hardly traded by late session on SIMEX in Singapore as traders searched for direction following Wednesday's yoyo markets.
Both Brent and NYMEX fell sharply on Wednesday following API data from the U.S. but rebounded as the downside ran out of momentum.
Technically, both markets appeared to be establishing a higher trading range.
By 0830 GMT June Brent, which expires later in London trading, was untraded but quoted at $19.48/$19.59, around the overnight London settlement of $19.51.
July traded at $19.55, up one cent from London with 10 lots registered.
Brokers said on Thursday that they had expected to find London and New York had fallen overnight, so now players were cautious ahead of the higher liquid trade of London.
NYMEX June futures were last traded at $21.38 per barrel, down one cent from New York.
